title: Strictly Come Dancing scores, series 1 to 15 (Four Tens)
what: Every Strictly Come Dancing performance of series 1 to 15 (2004 to 2017) with each judge's score, the published total, the dance and the song, plus the celebrities (occupation, age) and professionals, and each series' judging panel.
